stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data, and College Navigator for the Stamford campus (fall 2024): 10,937 applicants, 83% admitted (rounded; the admit count is not printed), 10% of admitted enrolled. UConn's Common Data Set (see the UConn page) is for the whole university, not Stamford, so no Common Data Set figures are used. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-time students; 265 sent SAT scores (28%) and only 15 sent ACT scores (2%), so the ACT percentiles are very thin. IPEDS lists SAT/ACT as required to be considered, but UConn's admissions pages say test scores are optional for the foreseeable future. UConn Undergraduate Admissions sets the admissions rules for all five campuses; only the regional-campus May 1 deadline and campus-specific cost differ. Applicant, admit and enrolled counts are the exact IPEDS figures for fall 2023, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.
